note: Private campground and trailer court (since 1966) on Hwy 61 at the north edge of Lake City, across the highway and a wooded strip from Lake Pepin. RV sites fill the eastern part along High St; mobile homes fill the western part. Mix of transient and seasonal. --Claude
summary: No operator website (Facebook only, unreadable beyond its description); visitlakecity listing refused (403). No posted nightly rate or working booking engine found; the property is half a mobile-home court. Google 4.3/85 with recent transient reviews. FLAGGED as a possible long-stay drop (test 2), reviewer's call. Phone confirmed; RoverPass (unclaimed) should leave website. Pin OK. Not waterfront confirmed. Note trimmed of field-repeating counts.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviewer's call), long-stay character test 2: the property is a campground AND a residential trailer court ('Lake Pepin Campgrounds & Trlr CT'; street map labels the western loops 'Trailer Ct'). Imagery shows roughly 40-45 mobile homes on the western Trailer Ct loops and between Trailer Ct and High St, and the RV area (the triangle between High St and Hwy 61, roughly 30-45 pads) on the east, so homes and RV sites are about even (test 5 not clearly failed). Test 2 cannot be shown passed: the operator has no website of its own, the Facebook page shows no rate without login, the Bookingmood booking page renders 'Nothing to book here', and the only listing with details (visitlakecity.org) refused me (403). The stored RV Life $$ tier does not stand in for a long-stay park. Against a drop: Google reviews show ordinary short stays ('We stayed here just one night as we were passing through' (5 yr ago); 'Not a bad place to pull in for a few days rest' (a month ago); 'We come here every year' (5 months ago)).

Google Maps: 4.3 from 85 reviews (passes the 4.0/25 screen). Review topics include 'traffic noise' (Hwy 61 and the rail line). RV Life: the park page shows no rating ('rating': null); the stored rating (4 stars, $$, 2026-06) is untouched.

Price gate: no operator rate found. A search snippet for the Bookingmood page claimed '$50.00 per night for May 1 to Oct 15, 2024' for an 'Overnight Site 3', but that page now renders 'Nothing to book here', so it is unread and unconfirmed; Campendium's $35 (June 2021) is an aggregator and too old.

Website: stored 'https://www.visitlakecity.org/lake-pepin-campground/\nhttps://www.roverpass.com/c/lake-pepin-campgrounds-trailer-court-lake-city-mn/' -> 'https://www.facebook.com/lakepepincamp/\nhttps://www.visitlakecity.org/lake-pepin-campground/'. The RoverPass listing is unclaimed (strip it); the Facebook page is the operator's own and the website Google lists. visitlakecity kept but unread (403).
Phone: 651-345-2909 confirmed (Google Maps and Lake City Chamber). The chamber's other number, 651-345-3990, is Smitty's Marine (the boat dealer at 1705 N Oak St).
Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. Lake Pepin lies northeast across Hwy 61 and a wide wooded strip; no site is near the water.
Pin 44.46255,-92.28649 sits at the office/Trailer Ct corner, about 90 m west of the RV area centroid (~44.4621,-92.2858). OK.
Unconfirmed (aggregator/derived only): 44 sites (26 full/18 partial), 45-ft rigs, pull-throughs, dump, season mid-Apr to mid-Oct (Good Sam directory says Apr 12-Oct 15). Left as stored.
